description: Single storey front extension incorporating front porch; single and two storey side to rear extensions; rear dormer; four roof lights in front roof slope and two to the side (Demolition of front porch, garage, side and rear dormers)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The proposed single storey rear
extension, given its depth and excessive height, would result in a detrimental
impact to the amenities of No. 123 Cambridge Road and No. 119&nbsp;Cambridge
Road, contrary to the Policy D3.D(7) of the London Plan (2021), policy DM1 of
the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The proposed rear dormer, by
reason of its size, design, and insufficient set-backs from the proposed first
floor roof form, would result in an a bulky and incongruous development; while the
excessive number of rooflights proposed on the front roof slopes, would result
in clutter to the frontage of the house, to the detriment of the character and appearance
of the house and the local street scene. &nbsp;The
proposal is thereby contrary to the high design standards of the National
Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3.D(1), (11) of the London Plan
(2021), Core Policy CS1.B of Harrow Core Strategy (2012) policy DM1 of the
Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></p>
